scope: WotLK 3.3.5a standalone/LAN and separately verified connected client
commonAcceptance: Track implementation status separately from verification status.
Finish the scoped rules, data connections, persistence, host authority and player-facing UI in the implementation phase.
Keep unsupported or unassessed content explicit until its implementation is completed.
Run build and package integrity checks for installable intermediate releases.
Defer comprehensive gameplay, class interactions, LAN, connected-server and PS4 acceptance to phase 2.
Retain prior test results as evidence without claiming they establish later complete-game correctness.
Public source preserves licenses and required build inputs and excludes private work logs.

packages.title: Inventory and acceptance criteria
packages.baseline: Complete ID inventory for the provided source snapshot. Unknown/unsupported implementation states remain explicit.
packages.acceptance: Every source quest, installed class spell and talent rank has a traceable status; unknown and unselected rows stay explicit.

packages.title: Reported console defects
packages.baseline: Action cursor, combat focus, mailbox visibility and Blood Elf intro have code changes but lack current console confirmation.
packages.acceptance: Reproduce each report on the current build and confirm the full interaction or intro on console.

packages.title: Combat events and procs
packages.baseline: Reviewed Lightning Shield, Water Shield and friendly Thorns profiles, charges/internal cooldowns, rank replacement, original-caster amount snapshots and selected shield/threat talents are implemented. Other trigger families, event kinds, critical filters and controlled proc chains remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Event source/recipient, trigger filters, chance, charges, internal cooldown and recursion rules pass positive and negative cases.

packages.title: Aura interactions
packages.baseline: Ordinary and mana absorption, strongest-only Frostbolt/Frost Shock NPC snares, periodic per-caster amount snapshots and target damage-aura views are implemented. Encounter epochs prevent stale periodic effects from reaching a reset/respawned NPC. Dispels, resistance, immunity, other controls and diminishing returns remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Dispel, resistance, immunity, control effects, diminishing returns and competing auras match the chosen 3.3.5a reference.

packages.title: Shared combat rules
packages.baseline: Source weapon ranges/delays, primary item attributes, class/race attack power, combat-rating conversion, independent main/off-hand swings, dual-wield penalties and local melee miss/dodge/parry/block/critical/glancing/crushing are implemented. Owner LAN combat outcomes and paperdoll values share these calculations. Weapon proficiency progression, conditional modifiers, active-ability blocking, spell/PvP rules, conditional resource modifiers and acceptance remain incomplete. Source class/level health and mana pools, Stamina/Intellect conversion, direct equipped pool bonuses, base-mana percentage costs and bounded non-refilling recalculation are implemented. Druid caster capacity is reconstructed on load and sent privately to the owner. Conditional form/attribute modifiers, conditional regeneration, full classes and gameplay acceptance remain incomplete. Base Spirit health regeneration and Spirit/Intellect mana regeneration now use 800 compiled class-level coefficient rows. Valid worn primary and direct regen stats (505 source items), actual-mana-use delay, two-second health/rage/runic cadence, hidden Druid mana and timed MP5 stacks are implemented. Original local UI uses the same source calculations. Conditional regeneration passives, food/drink, item spells/sets/scaling and gameplay acceptance remain open.
packages.acceptance: Cast interruption/pushback, including absorb and repeat/reconnect cases; hit, critical, avoidance, mitigation, threat, line of sight, range and target rules for each supported attack type.

packages.title: Stances and forms
packages.baseline: Eight ground-form/stance transitions, source masks, separate druid mana, resource recovery, saved form state, LAN views, original bars and local/remote model paths are implemented. Exact form-specific stamina, attack power, critical/armor penetration, immunity/tracking, entry-resource talents, further forms and console acceptance remain open.
packages.acceptance: Transitions apply and remove modifiers, enforce resources and update action bars without retaining old-form effects.

packages.title: Pets and stables
packages.baseline: No complete local acquisition, progression or stable service.
packages.acceptance: Acquire, command, level, save, stable, summon, kill and revive pets with authoritative ownership and movement.

packages.title: Channels, areas and totems
packages.baseline: Reviewed Chain Lightning and Chain Heal select up to three targets; Arcane Explosion uses the source radius and bounded multi-target damage. Other area profiles, ground targets, channels, totems, summons, reagents and their lifecycle remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Target selection, placement, periodic execution, interruption, despawn and resource consumption work through the real cast path.

packages.title: Warrior and Rogue
packages.baseline: Sinister Strike, Backstab and Eviscerate now use derived class/item AP, normalized weapon contributions and special melee hit/critical/avoidance. Avoidance retains combo points, reduces energy spending and applies no subsequent effects. Remaining warrior attacks, stealth/poisons, finishers, conditional talents and full class rules remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Every class spell/rank and talent effect is assessed, with combo points, finishers, stealth, poison and warrior attack rules covered.

packages.title: Druid
packages.baseline: Claw, Shred, Rake, Rip and Ferocious Bite now use derived feral AP, Cat swing speed, weapon AP contribution and special melee outcomes. Avoided attacks add no points/bleeds and consume no extra Bite energy. Full feral passives, conditional resource modifiers, other specializations and form interactions remain incomplete. Source class/level health and mana pools, Stamina/Intellect conversion, direct equipped pool bonuses, base-mana percentage costs and bounded non-refilling recalculation are implemented. Druid caster capacity is reconstructed on load and sent privately to the owner. Conditional form/attribute modifiers, conditional regeneration, full classes and gameplay acceptance remain incomplete. Base Spirit health regeneration and Spirit/Intellect mana regeneration now use 800 compiled class-level coefficient rows. Valid worn primary and direct regen stats (505 source items), actual-mana-use delay, two-second health/rage/runic cadence, hidden Druid mana and timed MP5 stacks are implemented. Original local UI uses the same source calculations. Conditional regeneration passives, food/drink, item spells/sets/scaling and gameplay acceptance remain open.
packages.acceptance: Every specialization works through form changes, resources, healing, damage and talent respec transitions.

packages.title: Paladin and Shaman
packages.baseline: Seal, judgement, weapon and totem interactions remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: All class ranks and talents apply the intended effect and remove obsolete modifiers on expiry or respec.

packages.title: Death Knight
packages.baseline: Base rune costs exist; diseases, death runes, presences and full talents remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Rune conversion, disease interactions, weapon effects, presences and companion abilities survive relevant save/LAN transitions.

packages.title: Mage and Priest
packages.baseline: Many control, protection and talent effects are absent.
packages.acceptance: Every class spell/rank and talent effect has implementation evidence and relevant cast, control and protection cases.

packages.title: Warlock and Hunter
packages.baseline: Full pet-dependent class behavior remains incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Class and companion abilities, control and resource interactions work with pet loss, replacement and respec.

packages.title: Cross-class coverage, glyphs and dual specialization
packages.baseline: Full talent trees, glyphs and dual specialization remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: No unexplained class/talent omissions remain; changing specialization cannot retain effects or spend points incorrectly.

packages.title: Item instances and durability
packages.baseline: Bindings, enchantments, sockets, random properties, bags and durability are incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Instance properties persist through equip, split, trade, mail, auction, bank, repair and restart without duplication or loss.

packages.title: Reputation and proficiencies
packages.baseline: Reputation progression and reputation-gated services are absent.
packages.acceptance: Progress, rank thresholds, discounts and service/equipment prerequisites are authoritative and saved.
packages.additionalScope: Audit and complete achievements, titles, character flags and other original progression systems as part of coverage; do not infer absence from an unassessed client path.

packages.title: Professions
packages.baseline: Supported crafting is bounded; gathering, specialization and non-item effects are incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Recipe and skill requirements, gathering, profession-specific effects and progression are checked per source recipe.

packages.title: Mounts and travel
packages.baseline: Ground ranks and direct taxi routes exist; flying, map UI and connecting routes are incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Taxi connections, riding ranks, flying restrictions and repeated transport seams work without stale coordinates or lost saves.

packages.title: Vehicles
packages.baseline: No complete local vehicle gameplay.
packages.acceptance: Seats, boarding, possession, vehicle actions, exit, death and quest interactions preserve owner/passenger state.

packages.title: General script runtime and phasing
packages.baseline: Original server script libraries are not executed by the local catalog.
packages.acceptance: Define and implement event scheduling, world state, conditions, movement, phasing and persistence needed by source scripts.
packages.additionalScope: Audit gameobject/world placements, scripted spawns, paths, conditions, schedules, phasing and daily/weekly world state.

packages.title: Quest chains and world events
packages.baseline: 919 adapted quests are not complete original quest coverage.
packages.acceptance: Every quest in the agreed source snapshot has requirements, objectives, rewards and scripts assessed; exclusions are resolved per content group.

packages.title: Instance lifecycle
packages.baseline: Bindings exist; difficulty, resets, lockouts and encounter progress are incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Entry, completion, wipe, reset, reconnect and party changes preserve the correct instance and encounter state.

packages.title: Dungeon encounters
packages.baseline: NPC/model data does not execute original encounters.
packages.acceptance: Each dungeon encounter has phases, mechanics, doors, rewards and repeatable wipe/reset/completion checks.

packages.title: Raid encounters
packages.baseline: Full raid scripts are absent.
packages.acceptance: Each raid and difficulty has encounter checks, saved progression and multiplayer completion/wipe behavior.

packages.title: Economy completion
packages.baseline: Retail bank, mail, auction and conditional vendor rules remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Item properties, fees, delivery rules, ownership and rollback are checked across simultaneous and repeated transactions.

packages.title: Raid groups, guilds and social systems
packages.baseline: Five-player parties exist; raids, loot rolls, guilds and guild bank remain incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Roster limits, permissions, loot rules, guild state and bank transactions work across disconnects and restart.
packages.additionalScope: Audit and complete friends/ignore/chat/emotes, guild ranks, guild bank and calendar-related interfaces where in target scope.

packages.title: PvP, battlegrounds and arenas
packages.baseline: No working standalone original PvP, battleground or arena system.
packages.acceptance: Player combat, faction rules, match lifecycle, objectives, rewards and ratings are checked separately for each mode.

packages.title: Playerbot completion
packages.baseline: Optional actors are not player-equivalent bots.
packages.acceptance: Navigation, rotations, roles and encounter reactions use the same authoritative gameplay constraints as human characters.

packages.title: Original interface and controller
packages.baseline: Original FrameXML loads; panel, layout and controller coverage remains incomplete.
packages.acceptance: Every in-scope panel has keyboard/modal/controller checks at 720p and 1080p with no hidden or unreachable required action.

packages.title: Rendering and audio
packages.baseline: Race intros, portraits and effect parity remain incomplete or unconfirmed.
packages.acceptance: Race/location/effect matrix confirms animation, presentation, sound and recovery from missing/failed assets on console.

packages.title: Streaming, memory and performance
packages.baseline: Travel, character changes and shutdown require long-run console checks.
packages.acceptance: Representative routes meet agreed frame-time/memory budgets; repeated loading and shutdown show no unbounded growth or reproducible crashes.

packages.title: LAN completion
packages.baseline: Host-authoritative messages exist; full multi-console behavior remains unverified.
packages.acceptance: Loss, duplication, reordering, reconnect, capacity and simultaneous actions preserve state at the agreed player limit.

packages.title: Connected-server compatibility
packages.baseline: Client paths exist; local tests do not verify compatible external servers.
packages.acceptance: Separate pinned AzerothCore, TrinityCore and MaNGOS runs cover login, character, travel, combat, items, social and match workflows.

packages.title: Whole-project acceptance
packages.baseline: Cannot be claimed from compilation or component tests.
packages.acceptance: All scoped requirements have evidence; save migration, extended console sessions and regression checks pass; remaining known issues are explicitly dispositioned.

phase1: Implement all scoped systems; build and package installable checkpoints. Missing console acceptance does not block unrelated implementation.
phase2: After implementation coverage is complete, run full gameplay, LAN, connected-server, performance and PS4 acceptance; fix defects and repeat affected acceptance.
